by: Claude (AI), before any score was looked at
about: Ten questions that name a shelf Act but ask for something the Act does not contain at all. Used only to see what the best within-Act score is when nothing is relevant, so that the floor below which the shelf hands over nothing can be chosen. No expected section.

questions.q: I want to file a consumer complaint against a builder. Does the Prevention of Corruption Act help me get a refund?
What is the minimum age to get a driving licence, and does the PC Act say anything about it?
How do I file for divorce by mutual consent under the POCSO Act?
What is the stamp duty on a sale deed, according to the POCSO Act?
Does the UAPA tell me how to get a refund of GST that I paid by mistake?
Under the UAPA, how many days of maternity leave is a woman entitled to?
Under the PMLA, what are the rules for adopting a child?
Is a tenant protected from eviction under the PMLA?
How is income tax worked out on agricultural income under the SC/ST Act?
Under the Atrocities Act, how do I register a trademark?
